calls.statement:
SELECT m.home_store_id, count(*) AS rows_cur, count(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS members_cur, min(join_date) mn, max(join_date) mx,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member x WHERE x.is_current) AS all_cur_rows,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member) AS all_members,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_cur
FROM dim_member m WHERE m.is_current AND m.home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136,900,999) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

WITH tam AS (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND home_store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND city='Tampere' AND store_id<900)),
act AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2026-10-04' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2026-10-04' AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test')
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM tam) AS members, (SELECT count(*) FROM tam WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM act)) AS active_52w,
 (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale, (SELECT max(join_date) FROM dim_member) AS max_join

SELECT count(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS loyalty_members_tampere
FROM dim_member m
WHERE m.is_current
  AND m.home_store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND city = 'Tampere' AND store_id < 900)
